title: vivo Y600 5G is coming and it will be familiar
author: Vlad
body_paragraphs: The vivo Y600 5G has just been listed in the Google Play Console, with the model number V2626. Its model number reveals the fact that it will be the same device as the Malaysian V80 Lite 5G as well as the Indian S2 FE, which is due to be launched on October 6.
The Google Play Console listing reveals that the vivo Y600 5G has 1260x2800 resolution, the MediaTek MT6858 chipset, 6GB of RAM, and Android 16 on board, rather disappointingly.

Like the V80 Lite and S2 FE, the Y600 5G is expected to have a 6.83-inch AMOLED screen with 120Hz refresh rate and 2,000-nit peak brightness, the Dimensity 7300e chipset, 6/8GB of RAM, 128/256GB of storage, a 50MP main camera, a 32MP selfie camera, and a 10,000 mAh battery with support for 44W fast charging.

title_tr: vivo Y600 5G geliyor ve tanıdık gelecek
body_paragraphs_tr: Vivo Y600 5G, Google Play Konsolunda V2626 model numarasıyla listelendi. Model numarası, 6 Ekim'de piyasaya sürülecek olan Malezya V80 Lite 5G ve Hindistan S2 FE ile aynı cihaz olacağı gerçeğini ortaya koyuyor.
Google Play Console listesi, VIVO Y600 5G'nin 1260x2800 çözünürlüğe, MediaTek MT6858 yonga setine, 6GB RAM'e ve Android 16 'ya sahip olduğunu ortaya koyuyor.

V80 Lite ve S2 FE gibi, Y600 5G'nin de 120Hz yenileme hızına ve 2.000 nit tepe parlaklığına sahip 6,83inç AMOLED ekrana, Dimensity 7300e yonga setine, 6/8GB RAM'e, 128/256GB depolama alanına, 50MP ana kameraya, 32MP selfie kamerasına ve 44W hızlı şarj desteği olan 10.000 mAh bataryaya sahip olması bekleniyor.
